rationale: torch_seq_transformer at default HPs underperforms torch_seq_gru (0/7 vs 1/7, avg_ann -7.6% vs +0%, avg_wr 29% vs 33%) — more attention-capacity made selectivity WORSE, not better. The negative finding is that the WR bottleneck is general across sequence-model families, not GRU-specific. Keep the prior GRU sweep on pos_class_weight / dropout — those knobs directly target the diagnosed WR-bound failure mode and the GRU's smaller capacity is acting as helpful regularization.
